newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins $20 mln Chinese network order.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins $20 mln Chinese network order.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Monday it won an order to supply a DCS 1800 cellular network to the Shanghai Post and Telecommunications Administration in China.
"Deliveries will commence in April and are valued at close to $20 million," Nokia said.
"This is a breakthrough for DCS 1800 in China and an important agreement for Shanghai mobile customers," it said.

Deliveries will include a mobile switching centre with potential capacity for up to 150,000 subscribers, a home location register, compact base stations and base station controllers as well as a full-scale network management system, Nokia said.
The Shanghai Post and Telecommunications Administration would to begin with concentrate on creating coverage and capacity in the 13-million resident Shanghai region, it said.
